items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I think Sonny Greer had spoiled him... Sonny Greer, who was not a great cymbaler -- but what he did to that band was what I tried to do to push a band... I saw him in Kansas City, but I didn't go up to him.

ctx.x: Well, I'm trying to say how did he get to be --

Well, I worked with Ben after Woody Herman, I'll have to get to that -- but that's one of the reasons that he wanted -- every time I wasn't with Ben Webster, when he had a little group of his own, he told the drummer, and the drummer would come running to me and say, "Gee, what kind of a cymbal is that that Ben keeps talking about?" and I'd say it's a Chinese cymbal with rivets, and Ben doesn't want to play behind anything else -- I think Sonny Greer had spoiled him.
Do you know that Dizzy Gillespie won't have a drummer unless he has that?
